entities.name: N-Boc deprotection
observations: Removal of an N-tert-butoxycarbonyl protecting group from a cyclic secondary amine gives the corresponding free amine; the aryl ether and pyridine-carboxamide framework remain unchanged.

entities.name: TFA in DCM
observations: Trifluoroacetic acid in dichloromethane is the directly matched reagent and solvent combination for this Boc deprotection.
Common alternatives include HCl in dioxane or HCl in ethyl acetate.

entities.name: Trifluoroacetic acid
observations: Acidic Boc-deprotection reagent; used with dichloromethane in the matched reaction record.

entities.name: Dichloromethane
observations: Solvent used with trifluoroacetic acid in the matched Boc-deprotection record.
